common_criteria.title: Control environment demonstrates integrity and ethical values
Board independence and oversight of internal control
Management establishes structure, authority, and responsibility
Commitment to competence is demonstrated
Individuals are held accountable for internal control
Quality information supports internal control objectives
Internal control information is communicated internally
Control matters are communicated to external parties when required
Objectives are specified with sufficient clarity
Risk to objectives is identified and analyzed
Fraud risk is considered in risk assessment
Changes that affect internal control are identified and assessed
Ongoing and separate monitoring activities are performed
Control deficiencies are evaluated and communicated
Control activities are selected and developed
Technology general controls support objectives
Policies are deployed through procedures
Logical access controls are evaluated from identity and authorization evidence
User registration and authorization are controlled
Role-based access is provisioned and reviewed
Physical access is limited to authorized personnel
Asset retirement prevents recovery of residual data and software
Logical access protections address threats from outside the system
Data transmission and movement are protected
Malware and endpoint protections are in place
Vulnerabilities are identified and remediated
Security monitoring controls are evaluated from runtime, audit, and detection evidence
Security events are analyzed to identify anomalies
Security incidents are responded to and contained
Recovery activities address identified security incidents
Changes to infrastructure and software are authorized and tested
Business disruption risks have mitigation measures
Vendor and partner relationships are monitored over time

tsc_extension.title: Capacity and performance are monitored against availability commitments
Environmental protections and backup processes support availability objectives
Recovery procedures are established, maintained, and tested
Confidential information is identified and protected
Confidential information is disposed of securely
Processing specifications define complete and accurate processing objectives
System inputs are complete, accurate, and authorized
System processing is complete, accurate, timely, and authorized
System outputs are complete, accurate, and timely
Stored inputs, processing items, and outputs remain complete and accurate
Privacy notice communicates objectives and practices to data subjects
Choice, explicit consent, and documented implicit consent for personal information
Personal information collection is limited to identified objectives
Collection methods are communicated and consented where required
Personal information use is limited to identified objectives
Personal information retention aligns with objectives and legal requirements
Personal information disposal is secure and documented
Data subjects can access their personal information
Personal data correction requests and denials are communicated
Personal information disclosure is authorized and logged
Authorized disclosure records are complete and current
Unauthorized disclosure records include reported breaches
Third-party privacy compliance is assessed and corrected
Third-party breach reporting commitments support incident response
Breach notification reaches affected people and authorities
Disclosure accounting is available to data subjects on request
Personal information quality is maintained and corrected
Privacy compliance is monitored and enforced
